'''Moon Cake''' was an establishment in the [[peacekeeping zone]] on the [[planet]] [[Plazir-15]]. A [[Color|white]] neon sign stating the business name in [[Aurebesh]], was used to attract potential customers. The business was located next to the nightclub [[The Orbit]].<ref name="Chapter 22" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the real world, the [[Wikipedia:Mooncake|mooncake]] is a [[Wikipedia:Chinese culture|Chinese]] pastry traditionally eaten during the [[Wikipedia:Mid-Autumn Festival|Mid-Autumn Festival]].<ref name="Britannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/topic/moon-cake|text=Moon cake|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20230409161912}}</ref>
